🎥🐕 The Dog Stars (2026)

In the aftermath of a catastrophic pandemic, a man has built a fragile existence far from what remains of civilization. Living with his dog and a fiercely protective companion, his days revolve around survival, routine, and avoiding the dangers beyond their isolated shelter.

When an unexpected radio signal reaches him from somewhere in the distance, it awakens the possibility that they may not be as alone as they believed. Unable to ignore it, he leaves the security of home behind and heads into an uncertain world searching for whoever sent the message.

The farther he travels, the more dangerous the journey becomes, forcing him to decide how much he is willing to risk for the chance to find people, purpose, and a life beyond simply surviving.

The Dog Stars, in theaters August 28th.

source_details.synopsis: The Dog Stars is a 2026 post-apocalyptic action thriller film directed and produced by Ridley Scott, from a screenplay by Mark L. Smith, based on the 2012 novel by Peter Heller. The film stars Jacob Elordi, Josh Brolin, Margaret Qualley, and Guy Pearce, and follows the survivors of a global flu pandemic in rural Colorado. The Dog Stars premiered at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square on August 20, 2026, and was released in the United States by 20th Century Studios on August 28. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and was a box-office bomb, grossing $39 million against a production budget of $70–110 million.
